read.thesis: Post-EDS spin "New Aptiv" posted Q1 adjusted revenue growth of just 1% and adjusted EBITDA margin down to 14.8% from 15.7%, with negative FCF of $362M; guidance gives FY26 pro forma adjusted EBITDA margin 18.6%.

triggers.label: EDS spun off as Versigent
triggers.quote: successful spin-off of our EDS business as Versigent on April 1
triggers.highlight: successful spin-off of our EDS business as Versigent

triggers.label: Adj. EBITDA margin 15.7% → 14.8%
triggers.quote: Adjusted EBITDA margin was 14.8%, compared to 15.7% in the prior year period, primarily reflecting increased commodity costs and unfavorable impacts of foreign currency exchange
triggers.highlight: increased commodity costs and unfavorable impacts of foreign currency exchange

triggers.label: Free cash flow −$362M
triggers.quote: The Company reported negative Free Cash Flow of $362 million in the first quarter, compared to $76 million generated in the prior year period.
triggers.highlight: negative Free Cash Flow of $362 million

triggers.label: Adj. revenue growth 1%
triggers.quote: Revenue increased 1% adjusted for currency exchange and commodity movements

red_flags.label: Negative operating cash flow Q1
red_flags.quote: Net cash flow used in operating activities totaled $143 million in the first quarter
